text:
sachin: Quick status — Tempest-8b quantized to int4 passed node-level smoke. Cost down ~2.8x, P50 latency +12ms, but seeing a small QA F1 drop on long-form (0.92 -> 0.88). Need rollout plan for hosted/dedicated/private.

aisha: Can you paste the smoke numbers and the eval sample that failed?

devon: Smoke run summary:
```
model: tempest-8b-int4
seq: 1024
throughput: 420 tok/s
p50: 58ms (was 46ms int8)
p95: 210ms
mem: 11.8GB
cost-est: -2.8x vs int8
```
Eval quick diff (sampled mega-qa):
```
baseline (tempest-8b-int8): F1=0.92
int4: F1=0.88 (drops concentrated on long-context multi-hop Qs)
```
Attached failing case: long chain-of-thought with citations getting truncated.

jamie: Hm — likely a quantization-induced tokenization rounding or stability in attention. Did you run with KV-cache warmup and same compilation kernels?

sachin: yes KV warmup used. Kernels: auto-selected. I re-ran a focused 50-sample set and the failure modes look like hallucinated facts near the end of long answers. Not catastrophic but visible.

ryan: Proposal for rollout gating: Hosted: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with metric gates at each step (F1 delta <= 0.02, hallucination rate <= baseline+1.5%). Dedicated: start with 10% reserved nodes (non-prod) then 30% prod-facing, manual approve. Private: manual ship with opt-in, include migration guide + eval pack.

aisha: For hosted canary, add automatic fallback to `tempest-8b-int8` after 15min if error rate > 1% or F1 delta > 0.03. Also enable prefix caching for common prompts to reduce regens.

devon: Added planned traffic split config snippet for routing (for infra):
```
route:
  - percent: 1
    model: tempest-8b-int4
    duration: 60m
    fallback: tempest-8b-int8
  - percent: 5
    model: tempest-8b-int4
    duration: 120m
    fallback: tempest-8b-int8
```
Note: will wire into smart routing rules (latency first).

eval-bot: Quick eval run queued: 2026-03-20T14:12Z -> 50 multi-turn QA, 50 summarization, 30 codegen. Results will post here.

jamie: Also add a prompt-level unit test harness for our top-200 customer prompts (run locally) to catch regressions before canary. We should flag any prompt with >10% BLEU drop or >0.05 F1 drop.

sachin: Agreed. I'm assembling the top-200 set now and will run overnight.

ryan: Rollout safety checklist (short):
- preflight: model card + quant checklist
- run full eval: QA, Summ, Code, Safety tests
- upload regen traces for top 20 failing prompts
- enable canary route + fallback
- monitor: token-level cost, p95 latency, error rate, hallucination metric
- manual stop with instant fallback if any gate trips

devon: One more note for dedicated: we should expose a toggled quant profile (int4 aggressive vs int4-conservative) so enterprise customers can choose. That buys us an escape hatch without full fallback.

jamie: Good idea. Also instrument attention-norm drift metric — it caught a similar issue in the past.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 1768130000 (unix ts) — will start with 1% hosted split. Watch channel for deploy events. :rocket:

sachin: Action items:
- devon: wire routing snippet and conservative quant profile (ETA EOD)
- aisha: prepare top-200 prompt harness + failure sampling (ETA +12h)
- jamie: add attention-norm drift check to eval suite (ETA +24h)
- ryan: finalize rollout doc and SLAs for dedicated/private (ETA +48h)

ryan: I'll also add the stop conditions to the runbook and reach out to support for on-call escalation.

sachin: Thanks all. If the eval-bot numbers look good tomorrow we proceed with the hosted 1% canary and the rest of the plan.

eval-bot: Results posted: QA F1=0.90, Summ rouge-L -1.2, Code exec pass unchanged. Flagged 7 prompts with >0.03 F1 drop. Full report uploaded to /evals/tempest-int4-run-20260320.json

aisha: Kicked off regression rerun on the flagged prompts with beam search tuned and alternative tokenizer setting. Will report back.

sachin: Perfect — we might be able to close the gap with a conservative quant profile + tokenizer tweak. Will reconvene after rerun. :eyes:
